# Tender response -- KVK-TEK-2026/11

Visakoivu Oy

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy has completed several comparable reference projects within the last five years, exceeding the required minimum of three.

3.2 Visakoivu's turnover in its most recent financial year is well above the required threshold.

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio is healthy and comfortably above the required 20%.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Routine maintenance visits at each school property are scheduled on a regular calendar, with content tailored to each site's systems and agreed with the contracting authority in advance of the school year.

4.2 A preventive maintenance plan is proposed for all systems covered by this agreement, reviewed annually and adjusted where a school's usage pattern changes.

4.3 Spare parts for common items are held in stock, with prompt sourcing arranged for anything not held, minimising downtime for affected systems.

4.4 The asset register and supporting documentation will be handed over to the contracting authority at contract start and again at contract end, in an agreed electronic format.

4.5 Energy-efficiency measures will be implemented and monitored across the properties covered by this agreement.

4.6 Fault reports receive a prompt and reliable response, backed by a standby (on-call) arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays across all school properties, with escalation to a senior technician if a fault is not resolved within the expected window.

4.7 A commissioning and testing procedure follows any repair or installation work carried out under this agreement, with results recorded and shared with the contracting authority on request.

4.8 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is arranged in line with statutory requirements, with results reported to the contracting authority.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 A discount structure is offered against the overall volume of the framework agreement.

5.2 Visakoivu's standard payment terms apply, in line with normal commercial practice for framework agreements of this kind.

5.4 Visakoivu's standard limitation-of-liability clause applies to this agreement.

## 6. Forms to be enclosed

6.1 CVs of the key personnel proposed for delivery of the contract are enclosed.

## 7. Format requirements

7.2 All monetary figures in this tender are rounded to two decimal places.

## Liite B

B.1 Visakoivu accepts the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met.

B.2 A certificate of Visakoivu's pension insurance payments is enclosed.

B.3 This tender is submitted using the Tender Form provided as Liite 1.
